references.pll_ref_donor: Tina U-Boot plat-sun60iw2p1/clock_autogen.h lines3-43; Linux ccu-sun60iw2.c39-55

independent_source_review.findings: PASS:23x3=69 readl; offsets bounded by two mappings; no CMD/IRQ/FIFO/read-clear targets; partial ioremap failure releases earlier mapping; no MMIO write/CCF/reset/regulator/MMC/DMA operations; CTRL concurrency and non-atomic/frequency limitations accurate.

hardware_accessibility: Real nonsecure bus access and resulting register values remain root-owned board validation, not guaranteed by static register semantics.

previous_v1_preserved.reason_for_v2: v20 live PERI1_CTRL40126310 is off; inspect already-enabled PERI0 instead of enabling a shared PLL.

reason_for_v3: Capture PERI0 distribution gate config/status and all first-step HS SDR timing/clock configuration together before v21 trial, without modifying hardware.
rebuild_scope: Unmodified previously reviewed v3 source rebuilt against v21; no added register or operation. Intended for separate25MHz and50MHz readback after each trial.
